name: Silent Waves
description: Silent Waves manufactures traveling-wave parametric amplifiers (TWPAs) for near-quantum-limited amplification of superconducting qubit readout signals. The company's product line (Argo, Carthago, Zephyr) enables single-shot qubit readout while reducing the number of cryogenic isolators required in the readout chain. Silent Waves was spun out of Institut Néel / CNRS in Grenoble.
funding: EIC Transition grant (~€2.5M); partner in SUPREME EU consortium (€25M, 23 members)

news.excerpt: Silent Waves launches the Zephyr, an integrated TWPA and pump coupler solution for compact, high-efficiency quantum readout

news.title: Breakthrough Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifier Isolator Published in Nature Electronics
news.excerpt: A collaborative team from Institut Néel, Silent Waves, with partners from Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and the University of Strasbourg has demonstrated a new superconducting travelling wave parametric amplifier isolator providing 20 dB forward gain and 30 dB reverse isolation.
